title: Why Imran Khan was asked to leave India after anti-CEC protests and what BJP's Kirit Somaiya said
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Star Imran Khan's participation in a Mumbai protest seeking chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation has landed him in an immigration row, with authorities directing him to leave the country by October 28 .

Adding to this, Star Imran Khan was among hundreds of people detained by Mumbai Police on October 10 (HT photo) The development follows a complaint by BJP leader Kirit Somaiya, who questioned the star's involvement in the demonstration despite his status as a foreign national.

Meanwhile, The Mumbai office of the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) served the notice on Khan, an American citizen registered as an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholder. Somaiya had approached the police over the star's presence at the October 10 gathering at August Kranti Maidan, prompting the complaint to be referred to the immigration authorities.

Notably, The episode has brought renewed attention to the restrictions governing OCI cardholders and their participation in political activities in India. While the status allows eligible foreign citizens of Indian origin several residency and travel-related privileges, it does not confer Indian citizenship. The action against Khan has also raised questions about the legal grounds on which an OCI cardholder can be directed to leave the country.

As per the latest buzz, Imran Khan was among hundreds of people detained by Mumbai Police on October 10 during a demonstration organised in support of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP). The protesters were demanding Kumar's resignation over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

In further updates, The gathering at August Kranti Maidan was called by Tushar Gandhi, Mahatma Gandhi's great-grandson, to express solidarity with the CJP's protest in Delhi. Police had deployed heavy security around the venue and detained demonstrators who attempted to reach the site.

On top of that, Mumbai Police shared permission had not been obtained for the proposed gathering. The force also cited Bombay High Court directions restricting protests to Azad Maidan. CJP workers, however, maintained that they had emailed the police seeking permission but had received no response.
Khan's detention drew attention after he posted a selfie from inside a police van on Instagram with the caption, “Apparently I'm going for a drive.”

title: Actor Imran Khan asked to leave India by October 28 after he took part in anti-CEC protests in Mumbai
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) in Mumbai has asked star Imran Khan, who was claimed to be an American citizen, to leave India by October 28.

Adding to this, Imran Khan was detained by the Mumbai Police on October 10 for participating in the anti-CEC protests in Mumbai. (HT Photo/Raju Shinde) The move came after Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Kirit Somaiya complained that the star, despite having a US passport and Overseas Citizen of India (OCI), had participated in Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)'s protest against chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar at the August Kranti Maidan in Mumbai Central on October 10.

Meanwhile, "The FRRO has taken the action and a notice was served to the star Imran Khan, who is [in India] on an OCI card. The star nephew of Bollywood star Amir Khan stays in Khar and was served the notice," shared a Mumbai Police official.

Notably, FRRO is the agency responsible for regulating the registration, movement, stay, departure, and visa extensions of foreign nationals. It operates under the Bureau of Immigration, Ministry of Home Affairs. It operates in close coordination with and through the police infrastructure.
As per the latest buzz, BJP leader Somaiya urged Mumbai Police to verify Khan’s citizenship and questioned whether a foreign national should be taking part in a political agitation.

In further updates, The star was born and educated in the US, but collected his livelihood in India while "participating in political and diplomatic activities opposing the government," he shared, according to news agency PTI.
On top of that, "I had sought a report on how long Imran Khan had been a US citizen," Somaiya shared, adding that he was grateful to the authorities for taking action.

At the protests, Imran Khan shared he was not present at the protests with any specific demands, but had come forward in his capacity as "a citizen". He shared he wanted to understand why freedom of movement was being restricted and why people’s voices were being suppressed.

title: Punjab bandh LIVE: Roads, tolls blocked, markets shut across state; protesters detained in Moga, Amritsar
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Protestors who refused to cooperate with the police were detained in Amritsar, Patiala and Moga Chowk. Punjab bandh LIVE updates: Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann on Wednesday vowed the strictest punishment for those involved in the murder of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota, as outrage over the daylight killing spilled into a second day and tensions remained high in Mansa town. Jhota's father, Bhim Singh, launched a scathing attack on the administration and called for a Punjab Bandh on October 15. The demand received support from opposition parties, farmer unions and the Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC). ...Read More

Adding to this, Hours after Jhota was shot dead in Mansa, the police on Wednesday arrested the accused, a pharmacy owner, Ashwani Kumar, from Rajasthan even as anger against the killing spilled onto the streets, with mob setting the chemist’s shop ablaze and authorities razing a portion of his house. Jhota’s father gave a Punjab bandh call on Thursday with political parties, including the Congress, Akali Dal, BJP, Akali Dal Waris Punjab De, and farmers’ body Samyukta Kisan Morcha and other farmers’ unions and state government employees’ unions extending support to it. The family has also refused to cremate the body.

Meanwhile, Punjab Bandh LIVE: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta on Thursday criticised the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) and Congress, accusing them of focusing on her, rather than highlighting the work being done by her government.

Notably, Taking aim at the opposition, Gupta also raised concerns over Punjab’s law and order situation, alleging that murders were taking place in broad daylight, people were dying by suicide and the drug mafia remained active in the state. She accused the opposition parties of remaining silent on these issues.
As per the latest buzz, "Murders are happening in broad daylight in Punjab. People are dying by suicide. The drug mafia is active there. But they do not speak on it," Gupta shared.

In further updates, Punjab Bandh LIVE: Police detained protesters in Patiala for allegedly forcing shopkeepers to shut their establishments during the Punjab bandh called over the murder of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota.

On top of that, Punjab Bandh LIVE: On the Punjab bandh call, Border Range IG Gurpreet Singh Bhullar shared around 1,300 police personnel have been deployed across the border range, covering Pathankot, Gurdaspur, Batala and Amritsar Rural. He added that senior officers, including SSPs, were personally overseeing security arrangements, while striking reserves and mobile units remained on standby.

Speaking about the situation at the toll plaza on the GT Road, which connects to the national highway leading towards Delhi, Bhullar shared traffic was moving normally and the situation remained peaceful. He added that police had taken action wherever necessary and “no one has been permitted to take the law into their own hands”.

title: Rahul Gandhi's visit, crackdown, hunger strike threat: Inside a long night at India Gate during protest by Ankita Bhandari's parents
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A police crackdown before dawn at India Gate in Delhi on Thursday brought a sit-in protest by the parents of Ankita Bhandari , who was murdered in Uttarakhand’s Pauri Garhwal district in September 2022, to an end after they were briefly detained.

Adding to this, Police personnel detain the mother of 19-year-old Ankita Bhandari, who was murdered in Uttarakhand in 2022, while protesting near India Gate against Dushyant Kumar Gautam's appointment as Sikkim governor, in New Delhi. (@INCIndia/X) Leader of the Opposition (LoP) in the Lok Sabha and Congress MP Rahul Gandhi had joined the protest the previous evening, along with several party leaders and workers. The protest opposed the appointment of former Uttarakhand BJP in-charge Dushyant Kumar Gautam as the Governor of Sikkim.

Meanwhile, Notably, the parents have demanded that Gautam’s appointment be put on hold until the ongoing Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) probe into the alleged VIP angle in the case is completed.

Notably, After Gandhi left, Congress leaders and workers continued the protest, raising slogans. Police moved in before dawn, briefly detained Ankita’s parents and removed the party workers from the site.
As per the latest buzz, Rahul Gandhi arrived with his sister, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, and other Congress leaders to express support for Ankita’s parents.

In further updates, Gandhi’s visit marked his return to the streets of Delhi, albeit for a different cause. On Monday, he led a large march from the Constitution Club to the Supreme Court to file a fresh petition against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

On top of that, After a 90-minute meeting with the family, the LoP wrote on X, “For four years, Ankita Bhandari’s family has not received justice, but a ‘VIP’ accused has certainly been rewarded with protection and a constitutional position…I and the Congress Party stand with them - in their grief as well as in this fight for justice”.

title: Karisma Kapoor reveals Salman Khan refused to shoot with her over her ‘too open, clingy’ outfit in Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

Karan Johar has returned with the ninth and final season of Koffee With Karan , with Salman Khan as the first guest to grace the iconic couch. The episode also brought a nostalgic treat for followers as Salman reunited with his Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge co-star Karisma Kapoor . During the conversation, Karisma recalled how the two would get into arguments on the movie's sets, revealing that Salman once refused to shoot with her because of her outfit.

Adding to this, Salman Khan objected to Karisma Kapoor's outfit in Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge. Salman Khan objected to Karisma Kapoor's outfit during Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge shoot Karisma opened up that Salman has a sweet tooth and recalled having chocolates with him at breakfast during the shoot of one of their films. She then opened up that they used to fight a lot too. Karisma revealed, "During Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge, the iconic outfit, I was very excited about my fashion, and I thought I was going to kill it, and he's like, 'What are you wearing? I will not give a shot with you looking like this.'"

Meanwhile, Karisma opened up that she had to go and complain to David Dhawan that Salman was not letting her wear the outfit. When Raja decides to marry Sapna, he must win over all three uncles, each of whom has a different idea of the ideal husband for her. The movie also stars Paresh Rawal, Om Puri and Anupam Kher as Sapna's uncles. The movie's music and Salman-Karisma's chemistry contributed to its popularity. The movie was among the commercially successful Hindi releases of 2000.

In further updates, Salman and Karisma were one of Bollywood's popular on-screen pairs in the 1990s and early 2000s, known for their chemistry in romantic comedies, family dramas and action films. The duo starred together in 11 films such as Judwaa (1997), Biwi No. 1 (1999), and Chal Mere Bhai (2000). body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In 2025, Deepika Padukone 's exit from Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit and Nag Ashwin's Kalki 2898 AD sequel sparked a debate about shorter working hours for actors on set. Ishita Dutta backs Deepika Padukone's 8-hour shift demand In an interview with Free Press Journal, Ishita shared she does not believe an eight-hour shift is an unreasonable demand. title: How an anime skull became Gen Z's protest symbol: What Neha Bora's red T-shirt means
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A red T-shirt worn by student activist Neha Bora during a Delhi protest has gone widely shared for its skull-and-crossbones symbol from One Piece, a Japanese manga and anime series whose pirate flag has become a symbol of youth-led protests across the world.

Adding to this, All India Students' Association (AISA) National President Neha Bora, advocate Prashant Bhushan, activist Yogendra Yadav, and CPI(ML) Liberation General Secretary Dipankar Bhattacharya lead a march near INA Market towards Jantar Mantar on October 10 (@_YogendraYadav on X) Bora, national president of the All India Students’ Association (AISA), wore the T-shirt during the October 10 protests over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and demands for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation. Protesters alleged irregularities in the revision process.

Meanwhile, The flag belongs to the Straw Hat Pirates, a fictional crew led by Monkey D. Luffy, whose adventures revolve around freedom, friendship and challenging powerful, oppressive rulers. Protesters, especially from Gen Z (born between 1997 and 2012), in countries such as Indonesia, Nepal and the Philippines have adopted the emblem to express resistance to authority and anger over corruption.

Notably, Created by Japanese manga artist Eiichiro Oda, One Piece began publication in 1997. It follows Luffy and his crew as they search for a legendary treasure called the One Piece. Luffy wants to become the Pirate King, but the story is also about his crew’s battles against powerful figures who exploit ordinary people.

As per the latest buzz, The series has sold more than 500 million copies worldwide. Its themes of freedom, loyalty and standing up to injustice have helped it develop a global following, extending from manga readers to viewers of its anime and live-action adaptations.
In further updates, The symbol on Bora’s T-shirt is the Straw Hat Pirates’ Jolly Roger, a pirate flag featuring a grinning skull wearing Luffy’s signature straw hat, with crossed bones behind it.

On top of that, Within the story, the flag represents the crew’s identity and its commitment to freedom. Luffy and his companions repeatedly challenge the World Government, a powerful institution depicted as corrupt and oppressive, and help communities facing exploitation.
That association has given the emblem a meaning beyond anime fandom. For protesters, it can represent resistance to powerful institutions and solidarity among people demanding change.

title: Delhi protest LIVE: Dipke urges political parties, youth, farmer unions, student bodies to join ‘Tiranga March’ tomorrow
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Abhijeet Dipke, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) Founder and National Convenor, along with Neha Bora (AISA) , Prakash Raj, Star and Activist during a press conference at Press Club of India. SC Delhi protest hearing LIVE: Amid tensions in the national capital, the Supreme Court on Thursday heard a series of petitions concerning the Opposition’s challenge to the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise and alleged police excesses, mass detentions and harassment of journalists and lawyers during anti-CEC protests in Delhi last week. ...Read More

Adding to this, Key takeaways from the Supreme Court hearing: SIR challenge: Notices issued on petitions challenging the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision exercise. Jantar Mantar: Government asked to clarify the decision to denotify the designated protest site. Journalists’ safety: Court termed molestation allegations against police “very serious” and considered a committee headed by a retired woman judge. Protection from coercive action: Relief granted to a woman journalist booked under the SC/ST Act. Preservation of evidence: Court directed authorities to preserve CCTV footage and other digital material. Alleged police excesses against lawyers: Notices issued on petitions alleging assaults and illegal detention of lawyers. CJP's press conference CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke on Thursday hit out at Prime Minister Narendra Modi, accusing him of bringing Delhi to a standstill to “protect” Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Addressing a press conference, he claimed that railway and Metro services had been shut down and Delhi had been turned into a “India-Pakistan border.” Furthermore, Dipke on Wednesday called for a ‘Tiranga March’ at Connaught Place's Central Park on Friday. The march comes in response to the jailing of co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. Ahead of the march, Delhi Police informed the Delhi High Court that all possible measures under the law would be taken against the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)’s call for supporters to gather with the national flag at Central Park on Friday. Anti-CEC protests in Delhi | Key developments - CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke has called for a Tiranga march in Connaught Place's Central Park. Dipke's call comes after his co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were remanded to five-days judicial custody in Delhi's Tihar Jail. -Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, co-convenors of the CJP, were jailed on Wednesday after their “preventive arrest.” The duo, along with 12 other CJP leaders, were detained on Tuesday morning after they breached Jantar Mantar and unfurled the tricolour, days after the site was de-notified as a protest venue. -Produced before a special executive magistrate on Wednesday morning, cops shared that they have a presumption that Das and Ranka “may commit a crime” if they are let go, leading to their preventive arrest and judicial custody. -Congress MP and Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi also showed support for CJP and condemned the jailing of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. Several other Opposition leaders also backed the pressure group. -Mumbai police has also issued a notice to Bollywood star Imran Khan, asking him to leave India by October 28 over his participation in the anti-CEC stir in Maharashtra.

Meanwhile, Delhi protest LIVE: The government on Thursday clarified that the Union Home Secretary’s affidavit before the Supreme Court, in response to a contempt notice, should not be interpreted as an unconditional apology.
Notably, It shared that beginning the affidavit with an unconditional apology is a mandatory practice in contempt proceedings, followed by the presentation of facts and arguments.

As per the latest buzz, "Some media organisations report that the Union Home Secretary has tendered an unconditional apology to the Honourable Supreme Court in response to a contempt notice. In this regard, this is to state:

In further updates, Whenever a contempt notice is issued by the Honourable Supreme Court, it is required that the party responding to the notice must begin their affidavit with an unconditional apology. Only thereafter all other facts and arguments are presented. This is mandatorily followed in every contempt petition."

On top of that, The government added that the affidavits filed by the Home Secretary, Delhi Police Commissioner and other officials followed this procedure and maintained that all actions taken by the government and police were lawful, with no case of contempt made out.

title: Ankita Bhandari's parents briefly detained during protest at Delhi's India Gate, mother threatens hunger strike
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The parents of Ankita Bhandari were detained on Thursday during their sit-in protest at India Gate in Delhi against the appointment of former Uttarakhand BJP in-charge Dushyant Kumar Gautam as the Governor of Sikkim. They were rolled out later.

Adding to this, Lok Sabha LoP Rahul Gandhi and Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra meet the parents of Ankita Bhandari, protesting against the appointment of BJP leader Dushyant Kumar Gautam as Sikkim Governor. (ANI) The parents of the 19-year-old receptionist, who was murdered in Uttarakhand’s Pauri Garhwal district in September 2022, have demanded that Gautam’s appointment be put on hold until the ongoing Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) probe into the alleged VIP angle in the case is completed.
Meanwhile, On Wednesday evening, Lok Sabha LoP Rahul Gandhi and Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi met the parents near India Gate and joined them during their sit-in protest.

Notably, Visuals shared by news agency ANI showed police taking Bhandari’s mother into custody. After being detained, she shared she would begin a hunger strike at their home if the authorities did not allow them to protest.

As per the latest buzz, "We want to state that we will remain steadfast until his (Dushyant Gautam) appointment is revoked... If we are not permitted to sit here, we will sit on a hunger strike in our own homes," she shared.

In further updates, Her father shared, “We give the government a 24-hour ultimatum: the appointment of Dushyant Kumar as the Governor of Sikkim must be cancelled. If it is not revoked, the people across the entire country will take to the streets, and the government will be held responsible.”

On top of that, Activist Yogita Bhayana also joined the protest, where Ankita’s parents appealed to President Droupadi Murmu to intervene and ensure that all allegations related to the case were investigated.

Expressing support for the parents, Rahul Gandhi accused the BJP of protecting a “VIP” accused in the case. In a post on X, he shared the family had been waiting for justice for four years, alleging that the accused had instead received protection and a constitutional post. “I and the Congress Party stand with them — in their grief as well as in this fight for justice,” he shared.

title: CJP, Congress push to restore protests at Jantar Mantar amid arrest of leaders
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The of late decommissioned protest site of Jantar Mantar brought the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) and the broader Opposition on the same page on Wednesday after three CJP members were jailed, triggering condemnation and a vow to restore the 18th-century observatory’s status as the Capital’s agitation hub.

Adding to this, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke along with party activists pose with the national tricolour following their rollout after being detained by Delhi Police near Jantar Mantar. (@abhijeet_dipke) Special executive magistrate Mahesh Kumar Meena remanded CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka to five days’ judicial custody for allegedly trespassing into a private property to reach Jantar Mantar and violating bonds requiring them to maintain peace.

Meanwhile, “The past conduct of both accused persons shows that they violated the lawful directions of the authorities. The present conduct of both accused persons shows that they are likely to breach peace and tranquillity in the area,” shared the magistrate’s order.

Notably, The controversial decision came a day after Das, Ranka and Ajinkya Shinde breached barricades, snuck into Jantar Mantar – no longer a designated protest site, after an order earlier this week – and raised the Tricolour, while shouting slogans against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
As per the latest buzz, Das and Ranka are among 11 people booked by the Delhi Police for entering Jantar Mantar by trespassing through a private premise.

In further updates, An FIR in connection with the incident has been lodged at Connaught Police Station under sections 223A (knowing disobedience of a lawful order issued by a public servant), 332 (house-trespass in order to commit an offence) and 61(2) (criminal conspiracy) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, while another FIR under BNS sections 221 (voluntarily obstructing public servant in the discharge of their public functions), 115(2) (voluntarily causing simple hurt to another person), 132 (assault or criminal force used to deter a public servant from discharging their duty), and other sections, was lodged at Parliament Street Police Station.

On top of that, “From the material on record, it is imperative that the above-shared respondents, after having executed a bond/bail bond for keeping the peace in pursuance of an order of SEM South West under Section 136 BNSS, have again committed breach of the bond/bail bond, which is evident from their conduct/social media posts and statement of complainant,” the order read.

Shinde was rolled out on a personal bond and a surety of ₹ 5,000. The other two –– who were previously detained from a flight on October 11 and rolled out after signing a bond –– were sent to Tihar jail .

title: Drishyam 3 box office collection day 13: Ajay Devgn film slows down ahead of Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 release, crosses ₹327 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings day 13 : Ajay Devgn ’s crime thriller has crossed the ₹ 300 crore rupees mark, emerging as the highest-grossing movie of his career. Now that Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 is gearing up for a nationwide rollout tomorrow, the buzz for Drishyam 3 stands significantly low midweek. Let's take a look at the ticket-window performance of Drishyam 3 so far.

Adding to this, Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings day 13: A still from Drishyam 3 with Ajay Devgn and Jaideep Ahlawat. Drishyam 3 dips midweek For Ajay Devgn, Drishyam 3 registered the biggest opening of his career. The advance bookings for Drishyam The Conclusion opened on September 27, and the movie went on to collect ₹ 27 crore rupees before its rollout. By the end of the day, the movie went on to collect ₹ 66.75 crore rupees net across India. This is the third biggest opening by a Hindi movie ever and the biggest in Ajay Devgn’s career. On the first Saturday, the movie collected ₹ 53.50 crore rupees, and showed huge growth on Sunday, bringing in ₹ 61 crore rupees. It is the highest single-day haul of the movie so far.

Meanwhile, The first dip started on Monday, when the movie collected ₹ 21 crore rupees, around 65.6% lower than its Sunday figure. The decline continued on Tuesday, when Drishyam 3 collected ₹ 19.50 crore rupees, and on Wednesday with ₹ 15.50 crore rupees. The movie drew an end to its first week at ₹ 245.50 crore rupees. The movie crossed the ₹ 300 crore rupees mark within ten days of rollout. As per the latest update on Sacnilk, Drishyam 3 collected ₹ 4.46 crore rupees on its second Wednesday in theatres. It is the lowest single-day haul for the movie so far. This brings the total ticket-window earnings for the movie to ₹ 327.96 crore rupees .

Notably, Drishyam 3 will face significant heat from Rajinikanth 's big rollout Jailer 2. The sequel is one of the most anticipated films of the year, and is set for a massive splash at the ticket-window, aiming to earn a staggering ₹ 140 crore rupees on its rollout day itself. By the morning of October 14 (Wednesday), the movie's advance bookings had crossed ₹ 80 crore rupees worldwide for its opening weekend.

As per the latest buzz, Drishyam 3 brings back Ajay Devgn’s Vijay Salgaonkar, along with Tabu, Shriya Saran, Rajat Kapoor, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav, and Kamlesh Sawant. Saurabh Shukla also reprises his role from the second part in a cameo.

title: Salman Khan calls Ranveer Singh ‘secure actor’, explains why his Dhurandhar performance cannot be compared with Ranbir Kapoor’s Animal
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

On the final season of Koffee With Karan , Salman Khan became the first guest of the season where Karan Johar talked about everything from his career to his health and beyond. During the conversation, Salman has shared why he would not compare Ranveer Singh ’s performance in Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar: The Revenge with Ranbir Kapoor ’s in Animal. During the premiere episode of Season 9, the star was asked to choose the more impactful performance between the two films. Instead of picking a winner, Salman explained how both actors brought different strengths to their roles.

Adding to this, Salman Khan was all praises for Ranveer Singh and his performance in Dhurandhar and explained why his work can't be compared to Ranbir Kapoor's Animal. Salman Khan on Ranveer Singh and Ranbir Kapoor’s performances During the rapid-fire segment, Karisma Kapoor made a special appearance to ask questions to Salman and host Karan Johar. She asked Salman which performance had made a greater impact, Ranbir Kapoor in Animal or Ranveer Singh in Dhurandhar.

Meanwhile, Salman refused to choose between the two, explaining that their performances were different in nature. He shared, “Two different kinds of performance. You cannot compare any of them.” When Karisma suggested that he was being diplomatic, Salman clarified that he genuinely felt both actors deserved equal appreciation.

Notably, He went onto say, “It is not diplomatic at all. Both are fantastic actors. One has got tremendous amount of energy. One has got tremendous amount of intensity. Both have different styles of acting.”

As per the latest buzz, Salman went on to explain what impressed him about Ranveer’s performance in Dhurandhar. The star is known for his energetic performances and larger-than-life screen presence, but Salman pointed out that the role required him to hold back rather than go all out. He felt that this restraint showed how comfortable Ranveer was with his character.

In further updates, He added, “Especially for Ranveer in Dhurandhar, he had to control all his energy. He does everything larger than life and he had to control that big time. For an star, that’s a huge amount of insecurity that he did not have it in the movie. He is very secure as an star and in that role in Dhurandhar.”
On top of that, Karan agreed with Salman’s assessment, responding, “Correct, well shared.”

Directed by Sandeep Reddy Vanga , Animal was rolled out in theatres on December 1, 2023. The movie follows Ranvijay Singh, played by Ranbir, whose complicated relationship with his father, Balbir Singh (Anil Kapoor), shapes much of his life. When his father comes under attack, Ranvijay returns home and sets out on a violent mission for revenge. The movie also stars Rashmika Mandanna, Bobby Deol and Triptii Dimri.

title: Homebound actor Vishal Jethwa: I am prepping for a Navratri singing gig next year; I connect more with music than with playing dandiya and garba!
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Having his roots in Gujarat, for star Vishal Jethwa , Navratri and Dandiya celebrations hold a special place. A passionate singer, who likes to express himself, he is looking forward to turning his hobby into professional singing and wants to start from Navratri.

Adding to this, Vishal Jethwa is looking forward to experiment with singing and feels Navratri gig is what he wants to do next! (Photo: Instagram) The star says, “Since I am a Gujarati, from childhood I loved playing garba-dandiya and now as a grown-up, more than playing, I love singing and being in the mahaul where there is a lot of music. Over the period of time, I have realised that I connect with music more by playing dandiya!”

Meanwhile, Jethwa, known for Homebound (2025) and Mardaani 2 (2019), is attending concerts of his friends, including singers Kinjal Dave and Geeta Rabari, this year, and followers might just get a surprise.

Notably, “I had planned to explore myself as a singer and do Navratri concerts this year but unfortunately, it did not work out. I will surely prepare for my music show next year. I keep looking at opportunities when I can express myself as a singer. It won’t be a surprise if I join for a bit and sing at any Dandiya night, but I know it will just be a cameo. Gane ka mauka milega to chodunga nahi,” says the star who will be next seen in Shakti Shalini .

As per the latest buzz, Expressing his passion for singing, he says, “I am very serious about singing and it took me many years to accept that more than acting, I enjoy singing – music and Gujarati folk. But fortunately, I am a better star than a singer. I know that I am a decent singer, but I need to work more on practice and rehearsals. I enjoy singing a lot and in the coming time, it won’t be a surprise if people see me sitting with a harmonium and singing. I am also keen to learn vocals and brush up my skill.”
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Vishal Jethwa (@vishaljethwa06)

On top of that, Vishal loves experimenting with fashion during Navratri celebrations. “I believe along with traditional, one should be open to modern dressing which can connect with youngsters and all age groups alongside trending fashion. I like to experiment with my dressing and make sure that our tradition of Gujarat and Garba is infused with contemporary fashion.”

He explains, “If I wear a very traditional dress, it will be too odd, and wearing just a modern dress won’t gel with festivities, so that balance is very important. I believe this way traditional dresses will stay relevant in the future as well, else it will fade off, and that I don’t want to happen.”

title: Indian Youth Congress chief moves Delhi HC against Jantar Mantar’s removal as protest site
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
Indian Youth Congress’s (IYC) chief Uday Bhanu Chib moved the Delhi high court against Delhi police’s decision to de-notify Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site in the Capital.

Adding to this, Delhi police on Monday denotified Jantar Mantar as a protest site, ending its 33-year-long designation as one of the country’s demonstration hubs. (Representational) Delhi police on Monday denotified Jantar Mantar as a protest site, ending its 33-year-long designation as one of the country’s demonstration hubs. They designated three alternative venues for protests: Ramlila Maidan, Burari Ground in north Delhi, and CBD Ground in east Delhi.
Meanwhile, While the first was spread across 12 acres and hosts thousands all year round, the other two are on the fringes of Delhi — 18km and 12.4km away from Jantar Mantar, respectively.

Notably, The order, titled “Guidelines for Holding Protests or Demonstrations in Delhi”, shared the Union ministry of home affairs constituted a committee to “examine alternative proper venues for citizen’s right for organising protest/demonstrations in place of the existing ‘designated site’”.

As per the latest buzz, “Based on the committee’s recommendations, Jantar Mantar as a protest venue has been de-notified,” the order shared, adding that three new venues were designated for organising protests and demonstrations.
In further updates, The application has been filed in Chib’s petition against Delhi Police’s denial of permission for a protest at Jantar Mantar.

On top of that, This was a day after the Delhi police told the high court on Tuesday that Monday’s notification was passed following a Supreme Court October 9 order earlier this month that nudged authorities to consider alternative, better-equipped spaces where residents could exercise their democratic rights without hindering public safety.

The Supreme Court on October 9 called for a rethink of Delhi’s decades-old arrangement of holding demonstrations at Jantar Mantar, recording that the Delhi Police commissioner and other competent authorities would consider designating an alternative venue with better facilities for peaceful protesters.

title: ‘Unwarranted and unacceptable’: India slams UN human rights office's concerns over Delhi protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Ministry of External Affairs ( MEA ) on Wednesday called the concerns expressed by the United Nations Human Rights Office over the Delhi protests “unwarranted” and “unacceptable”, accusing it of interfering in India's internal affairs.

Adding to this, ]MEA Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal addressing a press conference in New Delhi. (ANI Video Grab) Responding to the remarks during a media briefing, MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal shared the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) appeared to be following a selective approach in commenting on protests and law enforcement actions around the world.

Meanwhile, “... the concerns expressed by OHCHR (Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights) are unwarranted and at the same time unacceptable because it amounts to interference in India's internal affairs,” Jaiswal shared.

Notably, “It seems that they have an approach of extreme selectivity because they have not reacted in their public positions on protests which are happening or law enforcement actions which are happening in other parts of the world,” he added.
As per the latest buzz, Jaiswal warned that such an approach could undermine confidence in multilateralism and damage the organisation's credibility.

In further updates, “And if they continue on this path, then obviously it will lead to loss of faith in multilateralism. At the same time, it undermines their credibility as an organisation,” he shared.

On top of that, Earlier, the MEA had rejected the OHCHR's remarks on the events in New Delhi, describing its concerns as “misplaced” and accusing the office of unwarranted interference in India's internal affairs.

In a statement shared by the ministry on X, India shared the right to peaceful assembly was guaranteed by the Constitution and safeguarded by the country's institutions, an independent judiciary and a free media.

title: Arjun Bijlani gives clarification after wife's T-shirt with words referring to Prophet Muhammad sparks backlash: 'She was unaware of the meaning'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Television star Arjun Bijlani and his wife, Neha Swami, have issued a clarification after she of late faced backlash for wearing a T-shirt that featured words in Urdu referring to Prophet Muhammad. Her outfit sparked criticism online, prompting the couple to explain the circumstances behind her wearing it.

Adding to this, Arjun Bijlani and Neha Swami give clarification after T-shirt row. ‘Neha was completely unaware of the meaning of the writing’ In a statement shared by Arjun on his Instagram Stories, the couple clarified that the T-shirt had been gifted to Neha by a fan during their trip to Bangkok. Since the words were written in Urdu, she did not understand their meaning when she wore it.

Meanwhile, The note read, "We would like to address the ongoing situation concerning Neha Swami Bijlani and the T-shirt she was of late spotted wearing, which featured words in Urdu referring to the Prophet. Neha was completely unaware of the meaning and significance of the writing on the T-shirt when she wore it. There was absolutely no intention to hurt, disrespect or offend the religious sentiments of any individual or community. We sincerely respect all religions, faiths and beliefs, and would never knowingly do anything to hurt the sentiments of others."

Notably, While clarifying their stance, Arjun and Neha also criticised the trolls for directing abusive comments and threats at Neha. The note read, "While we understand that people may have strong feelings about matters of religious significance, the trolling, abusive language, curses and threats directed at Neha are deeply distressing and unacceptable. A situation arising from a lack of awareness should not become a reason to subject an individual to online harassment or threats."

As per the latest buzz, The statement further read, "It was a t-shirt gifted by a fan in Bangkok at a mall and we didnt know the meaning of what was written, we celebrate all festivals and we will never hurt anyone's sentiments in any way. We are sorry for what happened unintentionally and we will always be careful in future with regards to the gifts received."

In further updates, The couple concluded their note by urging people to approach the matter with understanding and refrain from targeting Neha and her family, "We request everyone to approach this matter with understanding. sensitivity and compassion, and to refrain from spreading hate or targeting Neha and her family. We believe that mutual respect and dialogue are far more constructive than abuse and intimidation. We hope this clarification helps put the matter into perspective and request everyone to allow the situation to be addressed with dignity and understanding.'
On top of that, View this post on Instagram A post shared by The Host (@thehost.global)

Neha of late wore the t-shirt while attending the birthday party of star Kunal Verma and star Puja Banerjee’s son in Mumbai after which she received backlash on social media. Meanwhile, the row also drew attention after Pakistani star Mishi Khan criticised the couple in an Instagram post and called for a public apology.

title: Protests kept 2.6 million commuters off Metro; 258 stations fully operational, DMRC tells SC
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) on Wednesday told the Supreme Court that the October 10 protests against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar had an adverse impact on the lives of ordinary citizens, with ridership falling by nearly 45% as many commuters chose not to travel, even as all scheduled train services continued to operate.

Adding to this, According to the corporation, the remaining 258 stations, which is more than 85% of the network, remained fully operational and accessible to commuters. (File Photo) In an affidavit filed, a day before the matter is scheduled to be heard, the DMRC shared around 3.2 million passengers travelled on its network on October 10, against approximately 5.8 million on a normal second Saturday. It attributed the sharp decline to the protests, which it shared appeared to have prompted people to forego their usual daily activities, including attending work or conducting business.

Meanwhile, The affidavit, filed in response to the Supreme Court’s directions on October 9, seeks to counter allegations that public transport was shut down in defiance of the court’s order. The corporation maintained that there was no reduction in the number of Metro train trips on the day, with 271 trains inducted into service and all 4,157 scheduled trips operated across the network.

Notably, The clarification comes amid contempt proceedings initiated by the top court over restrictions imposed on Metro and railway services ahead of the protest at Jantar Mantar, called by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) to demand Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over alleged irregularities in the revision of electoral rolls.

As per the latest buzz, On Sunday, a bench of justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana issued notices to Union home secretary Govind Mohan, Delhi police commissioner Anurag Kumar and DMRC chairperson D Thara, holding that a prima facie case in the contempt pleas against them had been made out. The authorities were directed to file their responses and compliance reports.

In further updates, The DMRC’s affidavit, submitted through its general manager, shared the Metro network comprises 303 stations, of which entry and exit gates at 45 were restricted on October 10 following directions from the Delhi Police. The original police communication had proposed restrictions at 57 stations, but the number was reduced after the Supreme Court’s intervention on October 9 and a subsequent reassessment of security requirements.

On top of that, According to the corporation, the remaining 258 stations, which is more than 85% of the network, remained fully operational and accessible to commuters. It also pointed out that interchange facilities continued uninterrupted at 14 of the 45 affected stations , including major hubs such as Rajiv Chowk, Kashmere Gate, Central Secretariat, Mandi House, Hauz Khas, Dilli Haat-INA and Netaji Subhash Place .
“The entire Metro network, except for the 45 stations specified in the modified notification dated 09.10.2026, remained fully functional throughout the day on 10.10.2026,” the affidavit shared.

title: Sharvari named first-ever brand ambassador of Reva by PNGS
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Sharvari is one of Hindi cinema’s most exciting young leads, with a growing body of work that spans diverse genres, from horror-comedy and action to romance. She made her big-screen debut with Bunty Aur Babli 2 and has since been seen in Munjya, Maharaj, Vedaa, Main Vaapas Aaunga and YRF’s Alpha . She will next be seen in Sooraj Barjatya’s Yeh Prem Mol Liya , slated for rollout in November. Sharvari will be the face of Reva’s brand campaigns across print, digital, outdoor and in-store, beginning with the festive and wedding season.

Adding to this, Amit Modak, CEO, PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Limited, shared, "Reva is entering a defining phase. Since our listing, we have been expanding with clarity, opening exclusive stores, launching our online platform and preparing to take the brand into new cities, including key markets in North India. As we grow beyond our home ground, we need a face that resonates nationally while staying true to who we are. Sharvari does exactly that. Her appeal cuts across regions and age groups, and she will help us introduce Reva and the value of a certified natural diamond to many more customers across India."

Meanwhile, Aditya Modak, Director, Reva by PNGS, shared, "Our very first brand ambassador had to be someone who truly reflects the Reva woman, and Sharvari was a natural choice in every sense. She is rooted, she is real, and she has collected her place through her own effort, much like a natural diamond is shaped over time. Today's woman buys diamonds not only for weddings but for herself, for her milestones and for her every day. Sharvari embodies that confidence, and together we want to make natural diamonds a part of more women's stories."

Notably, Sharvari, Brand Ambassador, Reva, shared, “Being the first face of Reva makes this association especially exciting for me. As a Maharashtrian, P. N. Gadgil & Sons is a name I’ve known and associated with trust and tradition for as long as I can remember. What drew me to Reva is how it brings natural diamonds into the everyday, with designs that feel modern while still holding on to the timelessness of the stone. I’m happy to be part of a brand that makes diamonds feel relevant to different moments in a woman’s life, from ordinary days to the most special occasions.”

As per the latest buzz, The Sharvari partnership comes as Reva accelerates its retail and digital expansion. The brand currently operates 38 stores, comprising 5 exclusive brand outlets and 34 shop-in-shop counters within the P. N. Gadgil & Sons network, with a strong presence across Maharashtra and a growing footprint in Gujarat and Karnataka. Recent openings include exclusive stores at Amanora Mall, Pune (July 2026) and Nashik (September 2026).

In further updates, Following its IPO in March 2026, Reva is on track to open around 15 new company-owned exclusive stores within 24 months of listing. The rollout will focus primarily on Tier 1 cities, with selective expansion into Tier 2 cities and metro markets across Maharashtra and key North India markets. In September 2026, Reva also launched its e-commerce platform, revadiamonds.com, bringing its collections to customers across the country. With a pan-India appeal, Sharvari will be central to introducing Reva to these new markets and a new generation of diamond buyers.

title: Kangana Ranaut backs Bittu Tabahi after river he cleaned for 8 months gets polluted again: ‘People cry about rights’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kangana Ranaut has expressed support for content creator Surendra Singh Choudhary, aka Bittu Tabahi , after he was left heartbroken to find the Ajnar River in his village in Madhya Pradesh’s Rajgarh district polluted again, just two months after he spent eight months cleaning it. On Tuesday, the content creator shared a video expressing his disappointment at how people had disregarded his efforts to keep the river clean.

Adding to this, Kangana Ranaut expresses support for content creator Bittu Tabahi. Kangana expresses support for Bittu Tabahi, slams public for polluting river Bittu’s video has been doing the rounds on social media. Kangana shared a news report about the incident and wrote, “This is so sad but also the brutal reality of our nation, people cry about rights all day but never think about their duties.”

Meanwhile, In the video, Bittu is heard saying, “Mere aanth mahine ki mehnat yun barbaad ho jayegi, maine kabhi socha nahi tha (I never imagined that eight months of my hard work would go to waste like this).” The clip shows the river strewn with waste, including flower petals, clothes and plastic discarded during religious rituals.

Notably, After seeing the river polluted again, Bittu resumes his cleaning efforts. He is seen removing garbage from the water and says in Hindi, “I don’t know how to swim, but I still step into the river to remove the garbage.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Surendra singh choudhry (@bittu_tabahi)

In further updates, Bittu became a widely shared sensation after sharing videos of himself cleaning the heavily polluted Ajnar River in his village. He spent eight months cleaning the river on his own, without external help or safety gear, often using his bare hands.

On top of that, His efforts collected him recognition on social media, including a shout-out from industrialist Anand Mahindra and a job offer from a Dutch NGO. In September, Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav also felicitated him and lauded his efforts to clean the Ajnar River. Bittu currently has 1.9 million followers on Intagram.

Bittu later participated in the Yamuna cleaning campaign in Delhi and was also seen taking part in cleaning drives in Gurugram, Mumbai and other cities. During his a three-day cleanup campaign in Delhi in September, Bittu had collected approximately 585 kg of waste with a team, as per reports.

title: Guru Randhawa announces The Sirra Era Live In Concert in Delhi on December 12; details inside
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Produced by Saregama Live in association with Rhythms and Warner Music India, the concert will bring together songs from Randhawa’s career, including some of his popular hits and more recent releases. The announcement also marks his first major live engagement in the national capital since 2023 and follows his last full-scale domestic tour in 2022.

Adding to this, Speaking about his return to the stage, Randhawa shared the break from touring was planned and described the soon-to-release concert as an opportunity to reconnect with the followers who have supported him throughout his career.

Meanwhile, “Taking a step back from touring was a planned pause, but standing here now, ready to step into a stadium, is incredibly surreal. My followers have been the absolute bedrock of this amazing journey, holding me up through every high and every low. This show isn't about me alone, it's my humble thank-you note to the people who built me. I wanted this homecoming to happen exactly where it all started, looking out at a stadium full of the faces who changed my life, and giving that love and respect straight back to my day ones!” he shared.
Notably, A post shared by Guru Randhawa (@gururandhawa)

As per the latest buzz, The singer’s soon-to-release performance is being positioned as a celebration of his 13-year journey in the music industry and his connection with listeners. The concert will feature tracks such as ‘Lahore’, ‘High Rated Gabru’, ‘Suit Suit’, ‘Patola’, ‘Naach Meri Rani’, ‘Made In India’, ‘Slowly Slowly’ and ‘Ban Ja Rani’. His more recent releases, including ‘Dopamine’, ‘AZUL’, ‘SHKINI’, ‘PERFECT’, ‘Qatal’ and ‘Sirra’, are also part of the revealed song catalogue.

In further updates, Siddharth Anand Kumar, Executive Vice President of Films, Series and Events at Saregama India, shared the concert aims to bring Randhawa’s music to a larger audience through a stadium-scale event. He also spoke about the wider role of live entertainment in bringing artists and audiences together.

On top of that, “Guru Randhawa’s music has a massive connect with audiences, and bringing him to a stadium in Delhi is about taking that connect to a larger scale. For us at Saregama, live entertainment is as much about bringing artists closer to their audiences as it is about building a strong ecosystem around these experiences. Shows like these bring together multiple teams, partners and businesses, all working towards one shared goal: delivering a great experience for followers. It’s this collective effort that makes the live entertainment business exciting, and we’re happy to continue being a part of it,” Kumar shared.

According to the organisers, ‘The Sirra Era Live In Concert’ will feature large-scale production and audio-visual elements designed for a stadium setting. They have also shared that environmentally conscious practices will be incorporated wherever feasible during the event’s planning and execution.

title: SC Constitution's watchdog, must bite if warnings don't work: Ex-Justice Kurian Joseph amid anti-CEC protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Former Supreme Court justice Kurian Joseph has shared constitutional courts must do more than raise concerns when their interventions fail to protect democracy, drawing an analogy between the judiciary and a watchdog entrusted with guarding the Constitution.

Adding to this, Justice Joseph shared declining public confidence in constitutional institutions had made peaceful public protests necessary when Parliament and the judiciary failed to protect democratic principles. (HT photo) “We have heard that famous saying that the barking dog seldom bites. But this watchdog, this guardian (the Supreme Court), is bound to bite also if the barking does not lead to the desired result,” Justice Joseph was quoted as saying by Bar and Bench.

Meanwhile, According to a LiveLaw report, the former SC justice also shared that the Chief Election Commissioner is “an institution, not a person” and the Supreme Court, as the Constitution’s watchdog, is “bound to bite” if its warnings don't work.

Notably, Speaking at a constitutional convention on the theme “Independence of Election Commission of India – Compromised?”, he stressed that courts must fulfil their constitutional responsibilities when institutions face threats to their independence.
As per the latest buzz, The event was organised by the Indian Association of Lawyers (IAL) of Kerala at the Kerala High Court Chamber Complex.

In further updates, His remarks come amid protests in Delhi demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar over allegations of irregularities in the revision of electoral rolls. The demonstrations have involved mass detentions, restrictions on movement and disruptions to public services, prompting the Supreme Court to intervene.

On top of that, Justice Joseph shared declining public confidence in constitutional institutions had made peaceful public protests necessary when Parliament and the judiciary failed to protect democratic principles.
Citing socialist leader Dr Ram Manohar Lohia, he shared, “When the Parliament and courts fail, then the street would come to our rescue.”

title: HC refuses interim injunction against release of ‘Queen Forever’ on Phantom Studios’ plea
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The Bombay high court on Wednesday refused to grant an interim injunction against Jiostar India Pvt Ltd. and the production and rollout of their forthcoming movie titled ‘Queen Forever’.

Adding to this, Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut. (Rahul Singh) A single-judge bench of Justice Sandeep Marne declined relief to Phantom Studios India Pvt Ltd, co-producer of the 2014 box-office hit ‘Queen’, which shared they and Jiostar India Pvt Ltd were joint and equal owners of 50% of all intellectual property rights in ‘Queen’.

Meanwhile, The court noted ‘Queen’ was a critically acclaimed and commercially successful movie that has acquired substantial goodwill and ‘Queen Forever’ was a purported sequel being produced by Jiostar India Pvt Ltd, co-producer of ‘Queen’, and like the original movie, stars Kangana Ranaut.

Notably, According to the suit filed by Phantom Studios, the co-production agreement expressly and unambiguously provided that derivative rights in the movie – including the right to create sequels, prequels, remakes, or any other work based on the movie or its characters, story or other elements – vest jointly and equally in both the parties, the suit shared.

As per the latest buzz, Phantom Studios described ‘Queen’ as a critically acclaimed and commercially successful movie that has acquired substantial goodwill since 2014. The studio shared it had not given consent for any sequels, adaptations or derivative works on the movie; it had also issued several caution notices to Jiostar since April 2026 to cease and desist from proceeding with purported plans for making a sequel or any other content that was likely to create any association with ‘Queen’. Despite the notices, Jiostar refused to disclose any details of the project, Phantom Studios shared.

In further updates, Citing extreme urgency as the movie is as per reports scheduled for rollout in a few months, Phantom Studios sought temporary injunction restraining Jiostar, the producer, and the representatives, from taking any step towards “making, developing, producing, shooting, completing, releasing, distributing, broadcasting, streaming, marketing, promoting, advertising, or exploiting” the “sequel, prequel, remake, adaptation or derivative work” under the title ‘Queen Forever’ or ‘Queen 2’ without its prior written consent.

title: Adivi Sesh writes to Assam government over reported resort development near Kaziranga National Park
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kaziranga, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is known for its biodiversity and population of the endangered greater one-horned rhinoceros. Concerns over construction and tourism infrastructure in ecologically sensitive areas have raised questions about how development can be balanced with the protection of wildlife habitats and natural corridors.

Adding to this, In his letter, Adivi called for greater transparency regarding the land involved and urged the government to assess the possible long-term consequences of the proposed development before making decisions that could affect the region’s ecosystem.
Meanwhile, “Nature does not belong to us; we are only its temporary custodians,” he shared, highlighting the importance of protecting Kaziranga’s wildlife and natural heritage.
Notably, Acknowledging the economic benefits of tourism, Adivi shared development in ecologically sensitive regions should be guided by long-term environmental considerations.

As per the latest buzz, “I understand that tourism can generate employment, create opportunities and contribute to the local economy. But development must be planned with a long-term vision, particularly when it concerns ecologically sensitive regions,” he shared.
In further updates, The star also questioned whether commercial development was necessary in every area, pointing to the potential consequences for wildlife and the environment.
On top of that, “Sustainable tourism should be about experiencing nature while preserving it, not about changing the very landscape that makes a place special in the first place,” he added.

Adivi also highlighted the importance of protecting wildlife corridors, warning that habitat loss and disruptions to natural ecosystems can be difficult to reverse. He referred to the greater one-horned rhinoceros as a symbol of Assam’s biodiversity and stressed the need to safeguard its habitat.

title: Harvard vs Harvard: Support from one, criticism from another over Delhi protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A group of 44 Harvard scholars and professionals on Wednesday raised concerns over what they described as attacks on India's constitutional institutions, including the Election Commission and the Supreme Court, asserting that while dissent is a right, questioning institutional credibility without evidence is not.

Adding to this, On Saturday, October 10, about 41,000 security personnel turned the Capital into a fortress on Saturday to thwart the planned protest and launched an unprecedented clampdown that saw the detention of 7,000 people and left large chunks of Delhi deserted. (File/ANI) In a statement, the signatories, who identified themselves as concerned citizens of India, the world's oldest and largest democracy, shared descriptions of the country as being under “siege” and constitutional authorities as “thieves” or “compromised” raised serious questions about attempts to erode public trust in democratic institutions.
Meanwhile, The signatories include lawyers, policymakers, civil servants, scientists and academicians.

Notably, "We are deeply concerned by the negative public discourse and concerted campaign against India's constitutional institutions, including the Election Commission, the Supreme Court, the office of the Honourable Chief Justice of India, and Parliament," the statement shared, reported news agency PTI.

As per the latest buzz, The signatories reiterated that while dissent is a fundamental democratic right, making unsubstantiated allegations that damage the credibility of institutions is not. They shared the statement was issued out of a sense of responsibility, adding that silence in such circumstances should not be mistaken for indifference.

In further updates, The statement, titled “Constitutional Responsibility, Rule of Law, and Institutional Integrity”, also flagged concerns over reports that Harvard University's name was being used to lend legitimacy to a political campaign without proper authorisation.

On top of that, The scholars shared actions taken by law enforcement agencies to maintain public order should be subject to fair scrutiny, but argued that sweeping allegations and abusive language could not replace evidence, due process or accountability.

“The dignity of public servants and the offices they hold must be respected. The Constitution, rule of law, and civil liberties must be respected at all times, not just when it suits our interests,” the statement shared.

title: Abhishek Pathak rules out part 4 plans despite ₹500 crore success of Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3: ‘We had to stop it at some point’
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

With Drishyam 3 continuing its strong run at the ticket-window, director Abhishek Pathak believes the franchise has reached its natural conclusion. The filmmaker has ruled out the possibility of a fourth instalment, saying the story has ended on a fitting note. Starring Ajay Devgn , the third movie has crossed ₹ 500 crore rupees worldwide in 12 days.

Adding to this, Abhishek Pathak reveals plans for Drishyam 4. Abhishek Pathak says there won't be Drishyam 4 In an interview with Screen, Abhishek shared he hopes October 2 continues to be celebrated as Drishyam Day and added, "All of us believe this is the last part of the movie. Obviously, the audience is loving it, and talking about it. But Drishyam isn’t the franchise where we can just decide to make another movie. It’s very much dependent on the story, and the story has ended. I always thought the ending was very poetic. It’s a love letter to the franchise."

Meanwhile, Abhishek further shared, "The closure is beautifully done. That’s what people liked about it. A lot of people are telling me there can be a part 4. If you get to it, there can be enormous amount of story to it, but that’s not the point. We had to stop it at some point, and this was a beautiful ending to the franchise. Drishyam 3 is only in its second week right now. People are still coming to theatres in huge numbers. The second weekend was more than ₹ 60 crore rupees. That’s a figure too many films don’t achieve even in their lifetime. So, let’s not spoil it for them."

Notably, Ajay Devgn’s Drishyam 3: The Conclusion has emerged as one of the biggest box-office successes of 2026, crossing the ₹ 500 crore rupees mark worldwide within just 12 days of its rollout. Directed by Abhishek Pathak, the crime thriller has collected ₹ 501.80 crore rupees globally, including ₹ 323.50 crore rupees net in India, according to Sacnilk. The movie opened with ₹ 62 crore rupees on its first day and collected ₹ 245.50 crore rupees in its opening week. Its strong second weekend further boosted its earnings, helping it become Ajay’s highest-grossing movie ever. It's now the second highest-grossing Indian movie of 2026, surpassing Border 2, Toxic, Jana Nayagan and Peddi's lifetime hauls.

As per the latest buzz, The movie sees Ajay's return as Vijay Salgaonkar, whose carefully guarded secrets face a fresh threat as a determined Crime Branch officer reopens the case. Tabu, Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta and Jaideep Ahlawat also feature in the movie. The movie received praise from Mohanlal, who shared, "I watched Drishyam: The Conclusion, and I am truly impressed with the way they have brought this much-loved journey to a befitting end. Congratulations to Abhishek Pathak, Kumar Mangat Pathak, Ajay Devgn, and the entire cast and crew on a job so well done."

title: Drishyam The Conclusion show-sharing row: Panorama Studios’ Week 3 show demands put exhibitors in a fix as Nayyi Navelli, Prahaar, Jailer 2 gear up for release
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , “The distributors have asked single-screen cinemas to allot at least 3 shows to Drishyam The Conclusion from October 16. In two-screen theatres, they have sought 5 shows, while in three-screen cinemas, they have asked for 6 shows, including 1 morning show. In four-screen multiplexes, their request is for 7 shows, including 1 morning show, and in five-screen multiplexes, they have asked for 8 shows, including 1 morning show. In six-screen cinemas, they have sought 10 shows, while for theatres with seven screens or more, their demand is for 15 shows.”

Adding to this, The source continued, “Their request has put exhibitors in a dilemma, as several films are lined up for rollout this week, including Nayyi Navelli, Prahaar, Street Fighter, Jailer 2, Ranabaali , etc. All these films have the potential to attract audiences, including the last two, which will also rollout in Hindi. As a result, cinemas are trying to negotiate with the distributors of various films and arrive at a consensus.”

Meanwhile, It is for this reason that advance bookings for the soon-to-release week are yet to open at several cinemas. When asked when the issue is likely to be resolved, the source replied, “It's difficult to say, going by recent experiences. The matter might be resolved by Wednesday morning or evening, or it could even extend to Thursday, just a day before the new releases arrive in cinemas.”

Notably, An industry insider commented, “ Drishyam The Conclusion still has a lot of gas left in the tank and can continue to attract audiences despite the competition. The makers have also asked exhibitors to sell tickets at regular prices, which should further entice moviegoers.”

title: 'Dande ka jawab': Rahul Gandhi uses flute in response to ‘police baton’ as protesters allege assault
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Adding to this, Congress MP Rahul Gandhi at a press conference on Wednesday Gandhi introduced a flute artist - Samar - who played ' Vaishnav jan to tene kahiye' song on the instrument in a symbolic answer to ‘danda’.

title: Mrunal Thakur on 'Pooja Meri Jaan': A woman's 'no' doesn't mean 'try harder'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Star Mrunal Thakur says she offered to audition for her role in "Pooja Meri Jaan" after listening to its one-line pitch about a trial in which the idea that a woman's "no means no, it does not mean try harder" is challenged.

Adding to this, Mrunal Thakur on 'Pooja Meri Jaan': A woman's 'no' doesn't mean 'try harder' Thakur, known for her roles in movies such as "Sita Ramam", "Hi Nanna", "Super 30", "Batla House" and "Dacoit", shared it is rare to come across characters with that kind of range.

Meanwhile, "The movie was not offered to me. I asked the filmmakers if I could do and be a part of it, I asked for an audition and shamelessly I was like, 'Sir, you've to cast me. I've to play Pooja'.

Notably, "I found out about it via my agent who shared, 'There's a movie being made which is about two girls fighting this case where 'no means no, it doesn't mean try harder'. I was like, 'I've to be a part of it. Can I meet? So, this is the second time in my life I've reached out to a filmmaker that was Dino . I'm just incredibly happy that he saw that faith and he saw that I can pull it off," the star told PTI in an interview.

As per the latest buzz, "Pooja Meri Jaan" follows Pooja , a free-spirited woman who rejects a marriage proposal from her longtime friend. After he dies by suicide, leaving behind a note blaming her for his death, Pooja faces public backlash, with many holding her responsible. Her lawyer friend Sana steps in to defend her.
In further updates, Thakur recalled her conversation with a man in his 40s during her recent visit to Delhi, who thanked her for the movie because it made him aware of the importance of consent.

title: ‘Where does CJP go when issues arise in other states?’ CM Rekha Gupta amid anti-CEC protests in Delhi
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta questioned the Cockroach Janta Party on Wednesday amid the recent protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar in the capital.

Adding to this, The chief minister shared the protests have caused Delhi "losses worth thousands of crores" and that this disruption is due to the ongoing sit-ins and protests. (Vipin Kumar/HT Photo) Addressing a press conference, the BJP leader questioned whether the pressure group has spoken about issues in other states. Track LIVE updates on Delhi protests

Meanwhile, “It is surprising that the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) is being questioned in this manner, even though it is not being conducted for the first time in the country. Such revisions have been carried out on numerous occasions over the years by the Election Commission. This has been the practice regardless of which party was in power, either at the state or the central level. Why were there no voices raised against it earlier? Why are such objections being raised now?” the Delhi CM told reporters.
Notably, The chief minister shared the protests have caused Delhi "losses worth thousands of crores" and that this disruption is due to the ongoing sit-ins and protests.

As per the latest buzz, "You want to oppose the system functioning in a democracy simply because you have failed to form the government. I want to ask... if you form the government in Tamil Nadu or Kerala, will such an exercise not take place there? Does this issue concern you only in states where you have failed to form the government?" Gupta asked.
In further updates, She also fired a salvo at CJP, reiterating the BJP's claim that the pressure group is the Aam Aadmi Party's "B-team."

On top of that, "Where does this CJP go when issues arise in those states? Why does it not go there to stage protests? Now, following the murder linked to drugs yesterday, why doesn't CJP go to Punjab and stage a protest? Why does it function as the Aam Aadmi Party's 'B-team', working only on the political agenda conveyed by the Aam Aadmi Party?" Gupta shared.

Gupta's remarks come after CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were sent to five-day judicial custody over their breach of Jantar Mantar, which was de-notified as a protest site earlier this week.

title: Farmers' protest at Karnataka toll plaza disrupts NH-48 traffic, Maharashtra Police suggest alternative routes
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Maharashtra Highway Police on Wednesday urged motorists, particularly those travelling long distances, to use alternative routes to avoid congestion along the National Highway 48 (NH 48), connecting Delhi with Chennai, due to a farmer protest at the Kognoli toll plaza in Karnataka.

Adding to this, The protest began on Tuesday over demands related to sugarcane and ethanol prices. (PTI) In an advisory, they shared the protest has affected traffic from Maharashtra towards Belagavi and Bengaluru on the NH 48. It added protest began on Tuesday morning over demands related to sugarcane and ethanol prices. The agitation was expected to end soon, but it was still underway, and there is no clarity on when it would be called off, the advisory shared. Motorists, particularly those travelling long distances, should plan their journeys accordingly, it added.

Meanwhile, Special Inspector General (Kolhapur Range) Ranjan Kumar Sharma shared it may take some time for the situation to return to normal. “Therefore, commuters are advised to avoid travelling towards Karnataka via NH 48 through Kolhapur, Satara and Pune unless necessary, and use alternative routes. We will issue an update once the situation improves.”

Notably, Kumar suggested using alternative routes. For passenger vehicles, including cars, jeeps, private vehicles and buses, he suggested the Satara-Rahimatpur-Pusesavalii-Vita–Tasgaon-Miraj-Kagawad-Raybag-Gokak–Belagavi route. For goods and heavy vehicles, including trucks, container vehicles and trailers, the Satara-Karad-Peth Naka-Islampur-Ashta-Miraj-Kagwad-Raybag-Gokak–Belagavi route.

As per the latest buzz, Police superintendent (Highway Safety Patrol, Pune ) Shivaji Pawar shared there was currently no obstruction to traffic within Maharashtra’s jurisdiction and vehicles could continue moving smoothly within the state. “The impact of the agitation on interstate traffic on NH 48 must be taken into account while planning journeys.”

In further updates, Pawar shared the authorities have requested Google Maps to mark the affected stretch as blocked due to the protest, display traffic delays and suggest alternative routes until the agitation ends.

On top of that, Police shared they would provide an update once traffic movement returns to normal. They advised motorists, bus operators and heavy vehicle drivers to follow the traffic advisory and cooperate with the police to avoid unnecessary congestion and delays.

title: Congress will face defeat in 2029: Amit Shah hits out at Rahul Gandhi amid anti-CEC protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Union home minister Amit Shah on Tuesday hit out at the Opposition, saying the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) will return to power with a resounding majority in 2029, hours after Congress leader Rahul Gandhi vowed that the ongoing protests against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar will continue.

Adding to this, "The Constitution has been torn up and thrown away. We are fighting together to restore democratic rule, genuine democratic rule in this country,” Gandhi shared after hosting leaders at his 5, Sunehri Bagh Road residence. (PTI) Citing the outcome of recent bypolls in states such as Gujarat, Rajasthan and West Bengal, where the Bharatiya Janata Party won, Shah shared the Congress leadership, particularly the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Gandhi, should reflect on recent defeats.

Meanwhile, “Rahul Gandhi should engage in self-reflection by learning from the election results. Instead of questioning the election process with every defeat, the Congress should reflect on its acceptability among the people. The trust of the people is collected not through mere allegations and propaganda, but through public outreach and public service,” he shared.

Notably, Earlier in the day, the Opposition revealed a “mission to restore democracy” that might include a political fight against the Union government’s decision to de-notify Jantar Mantar as a protest site. The parties also agreed to wait for the Supreme Court’s decision on their petition filed on Monday before another stir in Delhi .

As per the latest buzz, The leaders hailed Monday’s march to the Supreme Court as a major achievement and decided to form an INDIA plus group to accommodate political parties, activists, students and other organisations. It even discussed plans for a mock Parliament and flash agitations.

In further updates, “We are all standing here together as one. As I shared yesterday, there are no parallel protests. There is one singular protest, and the protest has one mission: restoration of democracy in India. Democracy has been destroyed in this country. The election system has been destroyed. The Constitution has been torn up and thrown away. We are fighting together to restore democratic rule, genuine democratic rule in this country,” Gandhi shared after hosting leaders from 12 parties, civil society members and student organisations at his 5, Sunehri Bagh Road residence.

On top of that, “The one method of expression of democracy was Jantar Mantar and now the government has decided that Jantar Mantar can no longer be used to express democratic feelings. Well, we are going to challenge that idea. It is not going to be so simple for the government to decide that the Indian people will not fight for their voice. The people who have done this, they need to understand that the net is closing around them. It is not going to be so simple that you can destroy the Indian Constitution and get away with it,” Gandhi added.

The developments came after a week of protests where tens of thousands of people hit the streets, braving expansive metro closures, internet shutdown, prohibitory orders and 40,000 security personnel who turned the Capital into a virtual fortress and sparked row by dragging, manhandling and detaining many agitators. While the Opposition is seeking the removal of Kumar and scrapping the controversial special intensive revision, the BJP blames them for trying to destabilise constitutional bodies to deflect attention from their own political and electoral failures.
